commands.label: CLASS-GUARD lane: PERMANENT, never selected by what a task happens to touch (maintainer ruling 2026-08-10, DRIFT-199-I001-017). VERDICT-CAPTURE RUNS FIRST and is the reason this lane is not optional: of the four defects existing fixtures caught in one session, three failed toward silencing or nagging, but the over-broad approval rule failed toward FABRICATION - capture inventing an authorization the human never gave. That is the one direction where a miss is unrecoverable, because a false authorization in the ledger is indistinguishable from a real one, so the T032 fabrication fixtures and the 23 not-approve cases must not be guarded only when someone happens to edit capture. The rest guard defect CLASSES structurally across the engine - the one path-identity primitive, the volume-derived case rule, and the machinery-path policy - where the file that breaks them is rarely the file being edited. The path-identity guard DID catch the third instance of its class the moment the call was written; it was simply never run, and a red guard was committed unnoticed. A guard only guards code whose author runs it. Roughly 20 s combined - cheap enough that omitting it can never be justified by budget.

commands.label: SLICE lane: the suites this slice touches, plus the workshop-authority suites added 2026-08-17. The beta3 workshop fixes (W10-W18) shipped with no lane covering them, so a walk regression could only be caught by someone remembering to run them by hand - the same 'a guard only guards code whose author runs it' shape the class-guard lane exists to prevent. The full deterministic registry is the RELEASE GATE lane and runs at the certification round, not on every slice (maintainer ruling 2026-08-10). The W29-W32 review-frame suite joined 2026-08-20: those four defects let a review be recorded as clean and independent while its frame held one planning document, so the guard belongs where a slice touching review machinery runs it. W33's declared-coverage suite joined it 2026-08-20: it is the only guard standing between a review that read nothing and a recorded clean pass, and it spans the candidate contract, the ingest degrade and the store's allowed-field list. W34's authorship and derived-independence suites joined 2026-08-20; they span the hook that observes the write, the store derivation, and the validator that recomputes it. The packaging-identity suite joined 2026-08-21: it pins the two mechanisms that turned out not to exist - a supported local install, and a build stamp derived from what is actually in the package.
